real_split: sample-ID SHA256 70/15/15, no claim of unseen-pretraining generalization
representation_input: same 34 numerical fields; chemistry only; all labels removed

targets.SigmaREE10: sum of all 10 measured database REE columns, require all ten positive
targets.Eu_anomaly: Eu_N/sqrt(Sm_N*Gd_N), external to all input schemas
targets.classification_loss: unweighted cross entropy; early stopping on validation CE, not test balanced accuracy

masked_recovery.mask_realization: one saved per record, shared by six representations
masked_recovery.external_fields: evaluate all observed isotope/age labels on the same masked-chemistry representation; these labels were never inputs
masked_recovery.probe: linear Ridge; alpha selected on val

process.modal_fractions: mass fractions; positive support Dirichlet, exact zero centers remain zero
process.major_mass_balance: remove actual source mass times delta F; cumulate compositions constrained by remaining oxide budgets
process.alteration_state: positive unclosed concentration law; no post-hoc closure that would alter the specified law
process.batch_melt_composite: excluded: first melt is not the source identity

operator.formula: dz/dt = A z + B theta + b
operator.theta: endmember, D, alteration a, instantaneous cumulate mineral controls, and progress parameter; physical controls scaled only on operator train
operator.mixing_condition: theta additionally contains the stage-initial latent; the raw source-chemistry block is zeroed. In composite rollout this latent is the PREVIOUS PREDICTION, never a true intermediate state
operator.MC_fit_policy: freeze operator fits and boundary thresholds after initial EpisodeBank, then append evaluations

bootstrap: paired median differences, clustered by initial-state ID; 2000 resamples; precision check against CI half-width 0.02; append only process families failing precision through max 8000

animation.selection_disagreement: max absolute V2 versus GeoNorm simplicity difference
